buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Experience Certificate for the supply of the same to any Govt/ PSU/ any renowned private organisation along with Supply/ Purchase Order. 2. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 3. Generic 1. The Seller shall not assign the Contract in whole or part without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 2. The Seller shall not sub-contract the Contract in whole or part to any entity without obtaining the prior written consent of buyer. 3. The Seller shall, notwithstanding the consent and assignment/sub-contract, remain jointly and severally liable and responsible to buyer together with the assignee/ sub-contractor, for and in respect of the due performance of the Contract and the Sellers obligations there under. 4. Past Project Experience

Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc.Proof for Past Experience and Project Experience clause: For fulfilling the experience criteria any one of the following documents may be considered as valid proof for meeting the experience criteria:a. Contract copy along with Invoice(s) with self-certification by the bidder that service/supplies against the invoices have been executed.b. Execution certificate by client with contract value.c. Any other document in support of contract execution like Third Party Inspection release note, etc. 5. Forms of EMD and PBG Successful Bidder can submit the Performance Security in the form of Account Payee Demand Draft also (besides PBG which is allowed as per GeM GTC). DD should be made in favour of Director, NCDC payable at Delhi . After award of contract, Successful Bidder can upload scanned copy of the DD in place of PBG and has to ensure delivery of hard copy to the original DD to the Buyer within 15 days of award of contract. 6. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses a. The tenure of engagement for any of the positions covered under this bid shall be co-terminus with the a ppointment of regular/permanent staff against the corresponding roles. In such cases, the Buyer shall prov ide a minimum of one month's prior notice to the Service Provider to facilitate adequate intimation to the d eployed personnel, enabling them to explore alternative career opportunities. b. In case a resource provided by the agency resigns, in order to address the issue of attrition, the agency shall provide a resource within 15 days of resignation. In case of non-compliance suitable action as per Ge M Provisions shall be taken that may lead to deduction of bill claim, and may further lead to forfeiture of P BG/Security Money and cancellation of contract in case of repeated violations. c. These posts are contractual and will not be treated as regular employees of NCDC. They will have no clai m for regular employment under NCDC. d. It is to be notified that the Manpower is to be deployed at NCDC-HQ located at 22 Sham Nath Marg, Civil Lines, Delhi-110054, as indicated in the published bid document, and the bidder has understood the scope of work and must mandatorily be required to deploy as per the contract obligation, including T& C and add itional T & C mentioned in the bid and the bidder must submit an undertaking on its letter head in this rega rd. e. The manpower on contractual basis through GeM, initially for one year or till the posts are filled on a reg ular basis, whichever is earlier. f. The deployed manpower shall be granted 30 days of Annual Leave (2.5 days for each completed month) and 10 days C/L or Sick Leave which shall not be carried forward/non-encashable and shall be lapsed on c ompletion of 1 year. g. The Experience and Educational qualification will be as per the ToRs, if applicable against any of the me ntioned posts in ToRs and will be treated as superseding clause contrary to any clause, if any, inadvertentl y mentioned in bid. h.
